text.en: A notochord is any hard support inside the body.

modelCorrection.en: A notochord is one particular structure, a flexible rod. A starfish has hard parts inside, and it has no notochord.

text.en: Amphioxus has a notochord and no backbone, and it is placed in Chordata.
"Non-chordate" means that an animal has no support of any kind.

modelCorrection.en: "Non-chordate" means no notochord. Beetles and starfish are non-chordates with hard skeletons.
